english:
Gain 10% increased Weapon Damage per mod while within 5 meters of a Vex Relay, maxing out at 50% with 5 mods.

Enhanced and regular mod copies do not stack.

source.text:
While within 5 metres of a Vex Relay:

5% [10%] Increased Weapon Damage per Mod.
Maxes out at 25% [50%] with 5 Mods.

Enhanced with regular mod copies do not stack.
